## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

HomeViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/home/HomeViewModel.kt

## Trigger

Home screen creation, in `init` — observed (already calls
`connectivityPermissionManager.onLaunch()`, its result just being
dropped); the reminder's action tap is a second trigger, to be added,
mirroring `onSensorPermissionReminderClicked`.

## Today

`HomeViewModel.init` launches `connectivityPermissionManager.onLaunch()`
and discards its result. `HomeUiState` carries
`sensorPermissionReminderVisible` for the sensor permission but no
equivalent field for connectivity. `HomeScreen` renders the sensor
reminder line and its "Autoriser" action via
`showsSensorPermissionReminder`/`onSensorPermissionReminderClicked`,
with no connectivity counterpart. `connectivityPermissionManager.requestAgain()`
exists and is already used the same way in
`ProfileViewModel.onAllowConnectivityClicked` (app-phone/.../ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt),
but nothing on the watch calls it.

## Expected

`HomeViewModel.init` keeps the result of `connectivityPermissionManager.onLaunch()`
and stores whether connectivity is denied
(`ConnectivityPermissionState.Fallback`), the same way
`currentSensorPermissionReminderVisible` is seeded from
`sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()`. `HomeUiState` gains a
`connectivityPermissionReminderVisible` field, computed in
`computeState()` alongside `sensorPermissionReminderVisible`.
`HomeViewModel` exposes an `onConnectivityPermissionReminderClicked()`
action that calls `connectivityPermissionManager.requestAgain()`,
updates the stored denied flag from a
`ConnectivityPermissionRequestOutcome.Resolved` outcome (visible
exactly when `Fallback`) and does nothing on
`RedirectedToSettings` — the same shape as
`onSensorPermissionReminderClicked` and as
`ProfileViewModel.onAllowConnectivityClicked`. `HomeScreen` renders a
reminder line and an "Autoriser" action when
`uiState.connectivityPermissionReminderVisible` is true, wired to
`onConnectivityPermissionReminderClicked`, next to the existing sensor
reminder block.

Second gap — resources: the sensor reminder's strings
(`WatchStringResources.Permission.reminder`/`action`, resource keys
`permission_reminder`/`permission_action` in
app-wear/src/main/res/values/strings.xml) are heart-rate-sensor
specific ("Capteur cardiaque non autorisé" / "Autoriser"). No
connectivity-specific reminder text exists on the watch side. A new
resource key pair (reminder text + action label) is needed for the
connectivity case, following TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md §10 (resource
file, French only, no hardcoded string), duplicated from the phone's
own wording if any exists there, since resources are never shared
across `:app-phone`/`:app-wear`.
